interpretation: Raw 30d volume grew while heuristic-filtered organic 30d volume fell between successive weekly snapshots. This is a deterioration in the publisher's volume-quality ratio, not proof of falling genuine customer spend or a trend in independent weekly revenue.
limitations: The weekly rows each describe overlapping rolling 30-day windows; the changes are not weekly sales growth rates.
The publisher's organic classification is heuristic and may change; not independently audited.
Wallets are not unique businesses, verified customers, or AgentMine users.
Facilitator shares are non-exclusive and should not be summed as market shares.
No AgentMine revenue, conversion, customer savings or willingness-to-pay evidence.
decision: Retain Phase 0; do not prioritize transaction-fee Agent Exchange on gross x402 flow. Seek consented, independently observed workflow value and repeat payment before monetization.
